name: Zhiada
description: A female human head warrior of Dirgur Sanctuary who killed a Kolaghan raiding party's orc leader and wears his teeth.

description_citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
description_citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: A Kolaghan raiding party disguised as merchants catches Dirgur's garrison off guard; Zhiada kills its orc leader.
timeline.quote: She personally killed the raiding party's leader, a huge orc, although the survivors fled with clan treasures.
